attackers_goals: Download a second stage payload for execution.
description: PowerShell initiates a Network Connection to GitHub with an uncommon command line. This may have legitimate uses, but this technique is frequently used by attackers to serve malicious payloads.
investigative_actions: Check if the initiator process is malicious. Check for additional file/network operations by the same PowerShell instance.
